headline: Not Amgen news: a market-research press release says a Phase III gout trial is still recruiting
reasoning: Source: an industry-report press release on ABNewswire ('Gout Clinical Trials Update 2026: Phasewise Pipeline Status, Drug Profiles and Key Developers'), relayed by Benzinga 15:01 ET: 'Amgen's Phase III clinical trial ... remains active and continues to recruit participants ... updated in the clinical trial registry on October 19, 2026'.
What changed: nothing. A registry entry for an ongoing study was summarized by a research vendor. Move: +0.03%.
objections: A pipeline-report advertisement about an ongoing trial.
